output.question: What are the details of the VMware acquisition?

output.answer: Broadcom completed its acquisition of VMware on November 22, 2023, and announced that VMware shares would cease trading on the NYSE. Announced on May 26, 2022, the deal valued VMware’s equity at approximately $61 billion using Broadcom’s May 25, 2022 share price, with Broadcom also agreeing to assume $8 billion of VMware net debt. VMware shareholders could elect $142.50 in cash or 0.2520 Broadcom shares per VMware share, subject to proration so that half of VMware’s outstanding shares received cash and half received stock. Broadcom’s stated strategy at closing was to modernize customers’ private and hybrid clouds, centered on investment in VMware Cloud Foundation.
caveats: The approximately $61 billion figure was the announcement-date equity valuation, not a final closing-date purchase price; the $8 billion net-debt assumption was stated separately. The exchange ratio is the historical transaction term.

key_facts.fact: Broadcom completed its acquisition of VMware.
The closing announcement stated that VMware common stock would cease trading on the NYSE.
The acquisition announcement valued VMware’s equity at approximately $61 billion, based on Broadcom’s closing share price on May 25, 2022.
Broadcom also agreed to assume $8 billion of VMware net debt.
Consideration was $142.50 cash or 0.25200 Broadcom shares per VMware share, subject to proration allocating 50% of outstanding VMware shares to each form of consideration.
Broadcom identified private- and hybrid-cloud modernization as its focus, with investment in VMware Cloud Foundation at the core.

citations.title: Broadcom Completes Acquisition of VMware
excerpts: SAN JOSE, Calif. , Nov. 22, 2023 /PRNewswire/ -- Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ: AVGO), a global technology leader that designs, develops, and supplies semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions, today announced that it has completed its acquisition of VMware, Inc.
VMware's common stock will now cease to be traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE).
Broadcom's focus moving forward is to enable enterprise customers to create and modernize their private and hybrid cloud environments.

citations.title: Broadcom to Acquire VMware for Approximately $61 Billion in Cash and Stock
excerpts: SAN JOSE and PALO ALTO, Calif. , May 26, 2022 /PRNewswire/ -- Broadcom Inc.

(NYSE: VMW), a leading innovator in enterprise software, today announced an agreement under which Broadcom will acquire all of the outstanding shares of VMware in a cash-and-stock transaction that values VMware at approximately $61 billion , based on the closing price of Broadcom common stock on May 25, 2022
In addition, Broadcom will assume $8 billion of VMware net debt.

Under the terms of the agreement, which has been unanimously approved by the boards of directors of both companies, VMware shareholders will elect to receive either $142.50 in cash or 0.2520 shares of Broadcom common stock for each VMware share.
The shareholder election will be subject to proration, resulting in approximately 50% of VMware's shares being exchanged for cash consideration and 50% being exchanged for Broadcom common stock.

basis.reasoning: The two official Broadcom releases provide the quoted completion, valuation, debt, election, proration, trading, and strategy passages. Their datelines identify publication dates and publisher.
